description: Separate one of your own Switch images into editable layers: a base plus transparent PNG layers, each named and placed. Seedream 5.0 Pro (the default) makes up to 16 layers. Seedream 5.5 (pass model) makes up to 99 layers, takes max_layers (2 to 100 pictures in all, 30 when left out) and can read the words in text layers (text_recognition); it costs 1 token a picture made at 1K and 1.5K and 2 at 2K. Say which image (asset_id, or "my last image"), optionally what to separate, and the size. Charged only for the layers that actually come back; a failed split is fully refunded.

asset_id.description: The id of your image to separate. "my last image" also works.

instruction.description: Optional: what to separate, e.g. "the outfit and the bunny". Leave empty to separate everything the model finds.

max_layers.description: Seedream 5.5 only: the most pictures to make, the base included. 2 to 100, 30 when left out. A bigger number separates more finely and holds more tokens until it finishes.

model.description: Which Seedream separates the layers. Left out = Seedream 5.0 Pro. Seedream 5.5 separates more finely (up to 99 layers) and can read text.

size.description: Output size for the layers. Auto follows the original image.

text_recognition.description: Seedream 5.5 only: also read the words in text layers. The words are noted on the layer; the layer stays a picture.

name: split_image_into_layers
title: Separate an image into layers
